mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cloudflare_zone WHERE zone_id = #{zoneId} AND is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cloudflare_prefix_pool WHERE zone_id = #{zoneId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cloudflare_prefix_pool WHERE zone_id = #{zoneId} AND is_assigned = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_prefixes, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_assigned = 1 THEN 1 END) as assigned_prefixes, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_assigned = 0 THEN 1 END) as available_prefixes, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN is_assigned = 1 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END as usage_percentage FROM cloudflare_prefix_pool WHERE zone_id = #{zoneId}
SELECT * FROM cloudflare_zone WHERE auto_assign_enabled = 1 AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT cz.zone_id, cz.name as zone_name, cz.status as zone_status, cz.auto_assign_enabled, cz.user_count, cz.user_limit, cz.dns_record_count, cz.dns_record_limit, cz.is_full, COALESCE(pp.total_prefixes, 0) as total_prefixes, COALESCE(pp.assigned_prefixes, 0) as assigned_prefixes, COALESCE(pp.available_prefixes, 0) as available_prefixes, COALESCE(pp.usage_percentage, 0) as usage_percentage, CASE WHEN COALESCE(pp.total_prefixes, 0) = 0 THEN 'NO_POOL' WHEN pp.available_prefixes = 0 THEN 'FULL' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END as pool_status FROM cloudflare_zone cz LEFT JOIN ( SELECT zone_id, COUNT(*) as total_prefixes, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_assigned = 1 THEN 1 END) as assigned_prefixes, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_assigned = 0 THEN 1 END) as available_prefixes, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN is_assigned = 1 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END as usage_percentage FROM cloudflare_prefix_pool GROUP BY zone_id ) pp ON cz.zone_id = pp.zone_id WHERE cz.is_active = 1 ORDER BY cz.create_time ASC

SELECT ucd.id, ucd.user_id, u.username, u.email, ucd.assigned_prefix, ucd.full_subdomain, ucd.status, ucd.dns_record_count, ucd.dns_record_limit, ucd.assigned_time, ucd.create_time FROM user_cloudflare_domain ucd LEFT JOIN user u ON ucd.user_id = u.id WHERE ucd.zone_id = #{zoneId} ORDER BY ucd.assigned_time DESC
